criteria.photon_materials: Inspected current Photon/Faithful front and rear screenshots: steel corner fittings, brass pinstripes, dark recessed panels and restrained teal stripe render consistently; no missing textures. Cast iron remains darker than edge steel.
criteria.scale_readability: Actual front/rear Photon views show complete square bed, longer barrel and clean saddle caps. The earlier exposed coplanar support top is removed.
criteria.states_motion: Running and later motion screenshots show changed wheel orientation with rim/spokes/hub together, while body remains fixed. Stopped and back views match the static component silhouette. Startup-back captured; this visual pass does not independently retest fuel logic.
criteria.interaction_guides: Cylinder/wheel guide captures use matching translucent geometry; held flywheel leaves guide aligned. Construction locations and recipes remain unchanged.
criteria.inventory_appearance: Controller/cylinder/flywheel hotbar icons retain their fitted transforms, and held controller shows the new steel cabinet/gauge material. This is screenshot review, not a comprehensive all-display-transform test.
criteria.integration_limits: Build/unit checks, all 182 server tests and focused Photon engine visual check passed. First expanded pipe test retained tank stock between rotations; reset its fixture stock and reran successfully. No moving-vessel claim.
